# Callouts: Recovery 6 - first boot on the bench: speaker, listener, supply

Source: Own photos, raptox's unit: stitched microscope mosaic of 2026-11-03 (~229 px/mm)  
Annotated image: [images/annotated/rec6-1_bench-boot.jpg](../../../images/annotated/rec6-1_bench-boot.jpg)

Speaker into J9. The adapter listening on J29's TX hole (assumed hole 1), its TXD unconnected. Strap off. Supply on JP5 with the limit at 1 A (500 mA reset the first start, 6 Nov). Listen for the beep, look at the LED side, read the log.

|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | JP5.1 | Pin 1 (square), VIN: supply + |  | Power | confirmed | Bench supply +5.0 V, current limit 500 mA, never above 6 V. The square pad, '1' printed beside it. Same copper as J8 pins 1-6, which is why J8's cable stays out. |
| 2 | JP5.2 | Pin 2, GND: supply − |  | Power | confirmed | Bench supply minus. The round pad, '2' printed beside it. |
| 3 | J29.1 | Hole 1: assumed chip TX |  | Debug / programming / test | guess | The dot end of J29, the only hole with top-layer copper. Which of holes 1 and 2 is the CC3220's TX is not yet known: this is the assumption for the first listen. To the adapter's RXD through 4.7 kOhm; the adapter's TXD stays unconnected. |
| 5 | J29.3 | Hole 3: GND |  | Power | confirmed | Rings to JP5 pin 2. '3' printed beside it. To the adapter's GND. |
| 6 | X4-X6 | Strap pads: nothing connected |  | Debug / programming / test | likely | The three round pads at the end of J14's strap traces, measured: X4 (top) = SOP0, X5 = SOP1, X6 (bottom) = SOP2. For this boot no strap: nothing touches them. |
| 9 | J9 | The speaker's plug |  | Connector | confirmed | 'J9' printed above it; the 2-pin speaker connector. The speaker on its own twisted pair plugs in here so the beep can be heard. |
| 8 | J8 | Cable out until reassembly |  | Connector | confirmed | The 30-way FFC connector to the power board. Its cable stays out on the bench: JP5 feeds the board, and nothing on J8 is used. The supply lines run round its bottom end, not to it. |
